q: The agency responsible for fighting human trafficking and child abuse in Nigeria is ____. (P6)
explain: National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons safeguards vulnerable persons.

q: The Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) is primarily responsible for ____. (P6)
options: preventing road accidents and enforcing traffic laws
explain: FRSC promotes road safety and issues driver licenses.

q: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) was adopted by the UN in the year ____. (P6)
explain: The UN General Assembly proclaimed the UDHR on 10 December 1948 in Paris.
hint: Post-World War II human rights charter.

q: The national motto written on Nigeria's Coat of Arms is '____'. (P6)
options: Unity and Faith, Peace and Progress
explain: The official national motto of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

q: Which agency enforces laws against illicit narcotics and drug trafficking in Nigeria? (P6)
explain: The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency eliminates illicit narcotics trade.

q: Civic duty (P6): Paying taxes promptly to the government is a civic ____.
explain: duty / obligation is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): Protecting public utilities like streetlights and water pipes is the responsibility of ____.
explain: all citizens is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): A citizen should always obey lawful orders from the ____.
explain: police and courts is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): Treating people of different ethnic groups and religions with kindness is called ____.
explain: tolerance and unity is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): Which of these is a civic responsibility of a student in school?
explain: Keeping the school compound clean is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): A child's right to life, healthcare, and education is protected by the ____ Act.
explain: Child Rights is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): When singing the National Anthem, citizens should ____.
explain: stand upright and pay attention is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): The Independent Corrupt Practices Commission is abbreviated as ____.
explain: ICPC is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): Refusing to join secret cults and violence in school demonstrates moral ____.
explain: courage and discipline is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P6): The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) was established in 1973 to promote national ____.
explain: unity and integration is the essential civic principle.
